column1: PART  I : Sec I : – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 20.11.2019
By virtue of powers vested in me by Section 3. of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) as amended by
Acts, No. 13 of 1966, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, that have to
be  read  with  Section  51  of  the  19th  amendment  of  the  Constitution  of  Democratic  Socialist  Republic  of  Sri  Lanka,I
Maithripala Sirisena, President  do by this order declare the Sarasalai Mangrove Forest of  1598.232 hectares bounded
